## Not tested

These have no run, so none of them is verified. Each reason is the actual state of this spike.

| Platform or item | Status | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows on real hardware (any GPU) | not tested | no Windows machine is available |
| Windows, GitHub-hosted runner, no GPU | not tested | the optional non-GPU CI job was not added: the spike runner's process accounting is macOS-only, and a `workflow_dispatch` workflow can only be started once its file is on the default branch, and merging to `main` was out of scope. Even if run, it would prove install and non-GPU storage checks only, never game compatibility |
| Linux | not tested | no Linux machine is available |
| Other Macs, other macOS versions, other displays | not tested | one machine only |
| Tauri 2 with WKWebView (H17, H18) | not tested | not run, decision-irrelevant (owner-approved scope change): per the decision rules Tauri wins only by passing a criterion Electron fails, Electron passed all fatal criteria measured so far except H7 (deferred to Phase 1), which Tauri cannot replace; and the save-transfer mechanism (ADR-0005) needs CDP, which WKWebView is assumed to lack (Assumed, runtime-and-storage.md sections 3 and 9) |
| Gamepad input | not tested | no hardware |
| Real Emscripten or Unity builds, heavy ports of commercial games | not tested | none is available; `progress-lab` only imitates the IDBFS layout. Their completeness is unproven |
